subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘PRAYER’ is written as ‘KIZBVI’ and ‘SCHOOL’ is written as ‘HXSLLO’. How will ‘TOMATO’ be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the alphabet are given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The logic followed here is the opposite letter of the alphabet series.

'**PRAYER'** is coded as **'KIZBVI'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f475e16bdfb7c673e2326b31461ee2d7ca2a19badef0137adac6809c71717986.png] 

**'SCHOOL'** is codded as **'HXSLLO'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ed987925cfc48ac420fc311e84da081fd279ebfdf6ecb55dcdb2e614c283f94.png] 

Similarly,

**'TOMATO'** will be codded as **'GLNZGL'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14f1ebe97278d5c4b36b12a72b36ef4764050a9bcd4079d67eb0d17e079dff2f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****GLNZGL".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Shortcut to remember the reverse positional letters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10143034955745197af4736695122f6c3b643817cc69dccb7445ad51f0508101.png]
